create_snli_eval: create an SNLIEval instance to load SNLI entailment data from a task path with a configurable seed
run_snli_evaluation: run the SNLI entailment evaluation by encoding sentence pairs and training a classifier to report dev and test accuracy
prepare_snli_samples: prepare SNLI samples for encoding by passing them through a prepare function with given parameters
load_snli_file: load a SNLI sentence file from a given path and return a list of tokenized lines
test_snli_evaluation: test the SNLI entailment evaluation pipeline with batched encoding and 3-class classification
